profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: I'm a Software developer who loves to code and can appreciate a nice unit test suite. I've been programming for over 10 years, and entered the workforce after graduating from Baylor in 2018. I have experience with the full web stack and cloud technologies, but I'm confident I can add value to any team with my drive to learn quickly, and the positive support I give my teammates.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Dove into AWS Development, building a Serverless Lambda application from the ground up before moving onto a team developing Fintech Web Apps in .Net as the company transitions our products in to the cloud. C#, Python, SQL, Terraform, Azure Dev Ops, AWS, and more.
positions.insights: python3, Amazon Web Services (AWS) and +1 skill

positions.title: Summer Intern - Software Development
positions.description: Got a taste of Web Product Development by working on the full stack of our application. Focused on work with SQL, .Net, C#, and Angular2. This was also the first time I'd been a part of large scale Gitflow in action.

volunteerExperiences.description: Help coordinate trips with company-formed groups to volunteer at donation distribution center.
